* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CesarVialpando.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Zeroing In|Zeroing In]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CesarVialpando.png]]CJ's garage, Doherty, San Fierro
|}

In this mission, you tag up with Ceasar to steal two cars from a car dealership near the docks of San Fierro. Begin this mission by heading to the dealership and stealing the cars. Follow Ceaser's lead and evade the police and use {{psx|L1}}/{{kbd|ctrl}}/{{xbox|B}} to activate the nitrous. Finish this mission by safely returning to the garage.

==Rewards==

* '''Cash''': $5,000
* '''Respect''': +5
